[Possessiveness Anthology] My Husband Is Jealous of My Ex

description:
“You are with him, but Oppa is with me. They’re different. Right?”

Lee Eunseo, a woman with a cute face, voluptuous body, and gentle personality.

Eunseo, who usually takes everything in stride, has only one worry.

It’s that her fiercely confident, highly narcissistic, extremely handsome husband, Go Jae-hyun, is jealous of his own self before losing his memories (why does he keep calling himself her ex-boyfriend...?).

A sweet and sultry love story with a handsome, jealous, doting husband who even keeps his pre-amnesia self in check!
